Built by Fidelo Website fidelo.test Category Identity, Compliance Docs Fidelo integration guide Contact Fidelo support About Fidelo Fidelo verifies identities with document checks, selfies and database lookups. Connected to Nodo, a passed check can open an account or issue a card on its own. What syncs Verification results, stored on each Nodo customer. Documents and selfies, kept for your audit trail. Watchlist screening, rerun every night for existing customers. How to connect Fidelo Open Integrations in the Nodo dashboard and choose Fidelo. Paste your Fidelo API key. Choose which checks each customer type needs. Decide what happens on a pass, a fail and a manual review. Getting help For questions about your Fidelo account, write to [email protected] .
